lines.text: Here's how to grow an online store with Google Ads.
You've got great products. But nobody's visiting.
First, lay the foundation: a clean product feed, conversion tracking, and a clear goal and budget.
Then pick your campaigns. Start with Shopping, plus a Search campaign for your brand.
Now, when someone searches for what you sell, your product shows up, with a photo and a price.
Of ten thousand people who see it, a few hundred click, and some of them buy.
Measure your return on ad spend. Four thousand in sales on a thousand in ads is four times.
Every week, scale the keywords that pay, and pause the ones that don't.
Then put more budget behind what works, and watch revenue climb.
Feed. Target. Measure. Optimize. And scale.
